reason: Adds the ignored error category list used to exclude selected categories from Channel Monitor V2 health scoring while retaining them in breakdowns.
risk: Adding a NOT NULL array column with a default can briefly lock channel_monitor_v2_config while PostgreSQL updates table metadata and validates the default.
mitigation: The configuration table contains only the singleton settings row, the change is additive and idempotent, and existing installations receive a safe empty list until later factory-default migrations run.
